title: True Detective

title: True Detective
description: Ray, Ani and Paul take precautionary measures to elude detection and untangle a dark mystery; Frank deals with the fallout of his betrayal.

title: True Detective
description: Frank, Ray and Ani weigh their options as Caspere's killer and the scope of corruption are both revealed.

title: True Detective
description: The disappearance of a young Arkansas boy and his sister in 1980 triggers vivid memories and enduring questions for retired detective Wayne Hays, who worked the case 35 years before with partner Roland West.

title: True Detective
description: Hays looks back at the aftermath of the 1980 Purcell case, including possible evidence left behind at an outdoor hangout for local kids; as attention focuses on two conspicuous suspects, the parents of the missing children receive a cryptic note.

title: True Detective
description: Hays recalls his early romance with Amelia, as well as cracks in their relationship that surfaced after they married; 10 years after the Purcell crimes, new evidence emerges, giving Hays a second chance to vindicate himself and the investigation.

title: True Detective
description: Hays and West see a possible connection between the local church and the Purcell crimes; as the detectives search for one suspect and round up another for interrogation, Woodard is targeted by a vigilante group.

title: True Detective
description: Wayne finds himself in a no-win situation as new clues emerge in the Purcell case; Roland wrestles with how to keep evidence secure as lawyers demand a new investigation; Amelia finds her relationship with Wayne imperiled.

title: True Detective
description: Wayne and Roland revisit discrepancies in the Purcell case that were hidden or forgotten, and take another look at Tom Purcell and Lucy's cousin, Dan O'Brien; the glitter of Amelia's book release is tarnished by a voice from the past.

title: True Detective
description: Wayne and Roland track down a man who left the police force in the midst of the Purcell investigation; Amelia visits Lucy Purcell's best friend in hopes of gaining insights into the whereabouts of the mysterious one-eyed man.

title: True Detective
description: Wayne struggles to hold on to his memories, and his grip on reality, as the truth behind the Purcell case is finally revealed.

title: True Detective: Night Country
description: When researchers suddenly disappear, Liz Danvers orders a search but tempers expectations of finding the men; Navarro tries to convince a skeptical Danvers that the men's disappearance is connected to the murder of local activist Annie Kowtok.

title: True Detective: Night Country
description: As Danvers and Prior set out to learn more about Tsalal, and find an unlikely location for the physical evidence, Capt. Connelly threatens to move the case to Anchorage; Navarro and Danvers separately find a connection.

title: True Detective: Night Country
description: While Hank leads the search for Clark, Prior asks Danvers about the murder-suicide case that drove a wedge between her and Navarro; Navarro and Danvers seek out a local hairdresser for insight on Annie.

title: True Detective: Night Country
description: Julia is struggling with mental health problems again; Navarro takes her to a clinic.

title: True Detective: Night Country
description: After Navarro rescues Leah from a volatile Silver Sky protest, Danvers gets a warning against pursuing the Tsalal case any further.

title: True Detective: Night Country
description: As the truth about Tsalal and Annie begins to unfold, Danvers and Navarro each confront the demons from their past.

title: The Hotline
description: An anonymous overdose hotline where people call before using drugs. Volunteers stay on the line, racing against time, creating collective hope amid addiction.

title: The Buffalo Miracle
description: The story of how strangers found sanctuary inside a McDonald's during a blizzard in Buffalo on Christmas Eve.

title: Mass Ave
description: A racial profiling incident forever changes the relationship between a man and his son.

title: The Slightest Touch
description: Emma has spent her life defying expectations; Emma and her longtime friend Colin Farrell embark on the challenge of completing the Dublin Marathon together; after running the full marathon himself, Colin joins Emma for the final four kilometers, pushing her wheelchair one kilometer for each decade that she has lived with EB.

title: Les Misérables
description: After 19 years as a prisoner, Jean Valjean (Hugh Jackman) is freed by Javert (Russell Crowe), the officer in charge of the prison workforce. Valjean promptly breaks parole but later uses money from stolen silver to reinvent himself as a mayor and factory owner. Javert vows to bring Valjean back to prison. Eight years later, Valjean becomes the guardian of a child named Cosette after her mother's (Anne Hathaway) death, but Javert's relentless pursuit means that peace will be a long time coming.

title: The Gilded Age
description: Agnes tries to regain control of the dinner; Peggy's career sparks a conflict with William; Ada meets Dr. Harris.

title: Goodbye Christopher Robin
description: After leaving London for the English countryside, writer A.A. Milne starts to spin fanciful yarns about his son's growing collection of stuffed animals. These stories form the basis for Winnie-the-Pooh and The House at Pooh Corner, published respectively in 1926 and 1928. Milne and his family soon become swept up in the instant success of the books, while the enchanting tales bring hope and comfort to the rest of postwar England.

title: Taking Chance
description: Lt. Col. Michael Strobl, a volunteer military escort accompanies the body of Lance Cpl. Chance Phelps to his hometown in Wyoming.

title: Prime Minister
description: Chronicling Jacinda Ardern's unexpected journey as New Zealand's 40th Prime Minister, this documentary offers an unfiltered window into her years in power.

title: The Lighthouse
description: Two lighthouse keepers try to maintain their sanity while living on a remote and mysterious New England island in the 1890s.

title: Mountainhead
description: Four friends reunite during worldwide economic turmoil.

title: The Post
description: Katharine Graham is the first female publisher of a major American newspaper -- The Washington Post. With help from editor Ben Bradlee, Graham races to catch up with The New York Times to expose a massive cover-up of government secrets that spans three decades and four U.S. presidents. Together, they must overcome their differences as they risk their careers -- and very freedom -- to help bring long-buried truths to light.

title: Dust Bunny
description: Ten-year-old Aurora asks a hit man to kill the monster she believes ate her entire family. To protect her, he'll need to battle an onslaught of assassins while accepting the fact that some monsters are real.

title: Saltburn
description: A student is invited to an eccentric classmate's estate for an exciting summer.
